body.objective: Define, before any BH-3 complex-frequency successor is created, an independent numerical-validation protocol that any prospective complex-frequency or quasinormal-mode computation must pass, cross-checked against the exact real-frequency invariants.
body.stop_condition: Specify the numerical method, discretization, convergence criterion, and error control for the exterior complex-omega boundary-value problem, as an independent rail distinct from the exact symbolic producers. Pin the exact real-frequency cross-check anchors (BH2_SYMBOLIC_CROSS_INVARIANT a(omega) on the real axis; BH2_GENERAL_L_STRUCTURAL horizon exponents; BH2C_METRIC_ALL_ORDERS asymptotics) that the numerical rail must reproduce before it is trusted off the real axis. Deliver the protocol as a specification and a reproducibility contract; do NOT run a quasinormal-mode computation. The protocol is the deliverable, not any spectrum.
body.forbid: no Conflux; no quasinormal-mode, stability, ringdown, scattering, or spectrum computation in this item; no numerical rail that reuses the symbolic producer as its own check; no protocol without a real-axis exact cross-check anchor
activates: the numerical-validation entry gate of the BH-3 proof-obligation DAG
body.resource_hint: Protocol-definition only. This item exists so no BH-3 successor is created without a pre-declared independent falsification rail (Science Forge independent-rail law). Do not begin a QNM solve.
notes: Phase 1 scheduling gate: the finite-flux radiation-class disposition closes first. ANY_TERMINAL does not assert that it succeeds or that its result is a mathematical input to this protocol.
